capture_ablation: large-colony reuse/reuse-panels retain the valid static-world snapshot: expected zero measured captures; plain/panels force one capture per frame. Diagnostic only; no production capture/admission policy changed.
precision_rule: Start with ten measured pairs. If primary 95% interval width exceeds 2 percentage points, extend all cases to twenty pairs once, regardless of effect direction. Otherwise stop; wide other intervals remain inconclusive.
multiplicity: Pointwise 95% intervals for phase estimates; report 99.5833% Bonferroni bootstrap intervals across twelve full-runtime comparisons as an additional family-level check.
panel_followup: Independent one-warmup/ten-pair targeted replication; 512 warm frames, 4096 measured frames, same binaries/settings. Not pooled with the original experiment.
